How to register a visitor? (Once the visitor is invited an email is send to him)
1. Access the url https://apps.iwaa.com .
2. Select the workplace.
3. Log in and click on "Visitor Management"
Begin by selecting the Visitor Management  module from the main menu .
4. Access the Dashboard
Once inside the module, navigate to the Dashboard  to view upcoming visits or schedule
a new one.
5. Click on "Add Visit"
To schedu le a new visit, click the Add Visit  button.
6. Register or Select Visitor
o If the visitor is already registered, search by name  to auto -fill their details.
o For new visitors, click on New Contact , fill in the required information, and click
Save Contact .
7. Altern atively, Use Map View for Booking
You may also go to the Map View  within the dashboard to select a meeting room
visually.
8. Select Meeting Room, Date & Time
Click on the meeting room where the meeting will be hosted, then choose the date and
time .
9. Enter Visi tor Details in "Extra Details"
Within the booking window, go to Extra Details  and enable the Visitor  option.
10. Add Internal Attendees (Optional)
Under Invite Attendees , you may include any internal team members attending the
meeting.
11. Add Pantry Services (Opti onal)
To request amenities like water, tea, or coffee , click the Services  tab and select the
desired options.
12. Visitor Receives Email to Confirm Details
The system sends an automated email to the visitor requesting them to confirm and
complete their detail s.
13. QR Code Sent Upon Confirmation
Once the visitor confirms, they receive a unique QR code  for access.
